turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dearest, you must rest now. We will see to the wedding and everything will be as you wish. Do not worry about the future, for we will manage and your son will carry on our family's legacy.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, promise me you will take care of our children and ensure they have a future filled with hope and opportunity.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please rest assured. Father and I will make sure everything is taken care of as you wish. Your hopes for our family will come true.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know you will, my son. And you, Wang Lung, do not neglect my words. Ensure our children's futures are secure, even when I am gone.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dearest O-lan, your wishes are our command. We shall ensure your legacy lives on, and our children will be proud of the family you have built.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please try to rest now. Father and my wife will help ensure your wishes are fulfilled.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I trust you both, but hurry with the arrangements for my eldest son's marriage. I must see it with my own eyes before I leave this world.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My love, your wishes are our path. We shall hasten the arrangements and ensure your eldest son is wed as you desire. Rest now, and know your family's future is secure.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, eldest son, you must listen to your father and take care of your new wife. Ensure your future is stable.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, Father, I will do everything in my power to make sure your wishes are fulfilled. I will take good care of my wife and look after our family's future.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dearest, do not fear. Your eldest son and I will make your wishes come true. Your family will always be strong and prosperous.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, eldest son, your devotion brings me comfort. Ensure that my final wish is your first priority.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I promise to honor your wishes and take care of my family. Please rest, and know your eldest son is committed to your peace of mind.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My love, your son's promise is as strong as the earth itself. Rest assured, your final wish is now a seed planted in fertile ground.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, eldest son, your words are a balm to my weary heart. Ensure that the marriage is arranged swiftly, so I may see my son wed and rest in peace.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will arrange the marriage swiftly and joyfully, as you wish. Your comfort and peace are my utmost concern.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Master Wang Lung, madam, I will prepare for the wedding arrangements immediately, as per your wishes.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, let us trust in the goodness of our family and the blessings of the earth. The wedding will be a celebration of life, and your spirit will be with us.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, eldest son, let there be no delay. I must see my son's happiness before the darkness claims me.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dearest, let us make haste with cheerful hearts. Your son's happiness will indeed bring light to your final days.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]
